messages.author: 82728a1d353801f9
messages.subject: Vector Autoregression in INLA
parts:
Dear all,

I am working on a dataset with discrete time (144 time points )and discrete space (37 locations). I wish to introduce a non-seperable space-time interaction effect using a Vector Autoregression with varying p at different location. Is it possible to do this in INLA?

Thanks a lot,

Xintong

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Vector Autoregression in INLA
parts:
On Sat, 2017-02-18 at 14:25 -0800, Xintong Li wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I am working on a dataset with discrete time (144 time points )and
> discrete space (37 locations). I wish to introduce a non-seperable
> space-time interaction effect using a Vector Autoregression with
> varying p at different location. Is it possible to do this in INLA?
>
> Thanks a lot,
>
> Xintong

Hi,the only option is to define this model yourself, using rgeneric,
see inla.doc("rgeneric") for how to do this. With only 37 locations,
you can just use a non-Markov model in space

ok?

H

you need to provide the precision matrix, and for the spatial part, you
